_comment: forest_canopy: Map 3's wood as map geometry, one chunk at identity. Every tree row of forest_trees.LAYOUT (113: 45 a, 30 b, 38 c) sculpted at its own place and scale against the real lane roof (forest_build's ground, whose underside dips over the trees on the deck only): the prop's trunk (its first eight rings, the cover footprint) with a buttressed flare ring at the foot, carried on -- thick, straightening -- to the roof itself (its top ring inside the sheet); three or four heavy primaries off the carried-on trunk at different heights, each sweeping up to a fork, carrying on into the roof, throwing a side limb off the fork and (two per tree) a thinner third limb higher up, every limb ending IN the roof; and the crown as many smaller overlapping leaf clusters -- one round the trunk's head, one round every limb's end, one loose -- every rim ON the roof's own triangulated underside (buried 0.10 m), each hanging its own depth, flanks leaf, undersides shade. Nothing of a crown passes the pit lip or the wall foot: tips stay over the lane, clusters are centred in and clipped to the deck annulus. Past the crowns' rims the FRINGE: four ragged rows of smaller clusters (about 370) hung from the roof's own surface, thinning as they go -- outward over the roof's cove (forest_ceiling_build.COVE_R, the roof curving down into the wall's head) and down it along its normal, so the foliage mass curves over and down with the wall; inward over the lip, spilling a little past it tucked under the drum's foot, nothing low over the pit. One material (the forest atlas, external PNG), every face unwrapped flat in its own plane at atlas density, one mesh of closed shells (one per tree, one per cluster). ForestCanopyCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node: every tree's own prop collider (forest_tree_prop_build.build_collider, the trunk's silhouette to ring 6) at that tree's transform, so the bake and the cover finder see the same triangles the 113 prop instances gave them. Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
